comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
no, `gles2_pure` is a renderer meant to be run on basically any hardware that can OpenGL, so it works with GPUs from 2004. It just panfrost sometimes is bugged, in this case it tells us the extension to make text rendering faster, but in reality it's broken.

Basically `gles2_pure` is the pure OpenGL ES 2.0 (on extra extensions, etc) renderer, `gles2` is what is being advertised along the gles2, and glsl3 is the original OpenGL 3.3 Core renderer. The perf increases the newer version of renderer is.
